reaction.notes:
Schema mirrors prior C_N coupling rule file to maintain compatibility. HTE-informed condition families for C–O coupling are incorporated, with Pd/biaryl phosphine systems and complementary Cu/ligand sets. Part of the HTE frequency ranking (RockPhos, BippyPhos, tBuXPhos; and CuI with diamines, phenanthroline, L-proline; Cu2O/salicylaldoxime) derives from Table 5 (top-hit counts) of the AbbVie HTE platform report covering 2017–2023 screens. fileciteturn0file0 Field names, token style, and sectioning follow the example C_N coupling JSON. fileciteturn0file1

General guidance: Start with Pd/biaryl phosphine + Cs2CO3 in toluene at 90–110 °C for phenols and less hindered alcohols; pivot to Cu/ligand sets (acetonitrile/DMF/DMSO; KOtBu/K3PO4/Cs2CO3) when Pd sets fail or for base‑tolerant aliphatic alcohols. Alkyl (esp. tertiary) alcohol O‑arylation remains challenging and may show low success; screen Cu sets early.

applies_if.expr: (Ar-Br OR Ar-Cl OR Ar-F OR Ar-I OR Ar-OMs OR Ar-OTf OR Ar-OTs OR Arom-Br OR Arom-Cl OR Arom-F OR Arom-I OR Arom-OMs OR Arom-OTf OR Arom-OTs OR Vinyl-Br OR Vinyl-Cl OR Vinyl-F OR Vinyl-I OR Vinyl-OMs OR Vinyl-OTf OR Vinyl-OTs) AND (Any-OH OR Ar-OH OR Arom-OH OR Bn-OH OR Allyl-OH OR Vinyl-OH)

default_rule.description: General starter for Ar–O coupling. Pd/biaryl phosphine + Cs2CO3 in toluene; seal and heat.

conditions.notes: Dry glassware; strong agitation. If stalled by 6–8 h, add 2–4 mol% Pd.

base_rules.name: Phenols / ArOH (best case for Pd)
base_rules.description: Unhindered phenols with aryl bromides/iodides; Pd + Cs2CO3/toluene frequently ranks top in HTE.

reactant_features.expr: (Ar-OH OR Arom-OH) AND (Ar-Br OR Ar-I OR Arom-Br OR Arom-I)

conditions.pd_precatalyst: G-series/allyl/crotyl Pd with RockPhos or BippyPhos

base_rules.name: Aliphatic alcohols (ROH)
base_rules.description: More challenging; Cu/ligand sets often outperform Pd. Pre-form alkoxide in situ where compatible.

reactant_features.expr: Any-OH OR Bn-OH OR Allyl-OH OR Vinyl-OH

conditions.ligand: trans-1,2-cyclohexane-dimethanamine or 1,10-phenanthroline or L-proline or salicylaldoxime

base_rules.name: Hindered or tertiary alcohols
base_rules.description: Low reactivity; try Pd biaryl phosphines first, then Cu sets. Expect modest yields; consider alternate routes.

base_rules.name: Aryl chlorides or five‑member heteroaryl halides
base_rules.description: More demanding electrophiles; use more active Pd systems and higher temperature.

base_rules.name: Pd in situ (no precatalyst vial)
base_rules.description: In-situ Pd source where precatalyst unavailable; slower start-up; watch for dba inhibition.

when: symptom:slow or no conversion by 6–8 h
modifiers.suggest: Raise to 110–120 °C (sealed vial, pressure-rated) if substrate stability allows.
Switch to CuI/Cu2O with diamine/phenanthroline/L-proline/salicylaldoxime in MeCN/DMF/DMSO; base KOtBu or K3PO4/Cs2CO3.
Increase solvent volume or change to MeCN/DMF; ensure strong agitation (vortex or overhead).
Use K3PO4 over KOtBu; lower temperature and shorten time; consider Pd path with milder base.
Reactivity trend I ≈ Br ≫ Cl; prefer ArBr/I for C–O. For ArCl, use more active Pd ligand (tBuXPhos/RockPhos) and higher T.
Keep water low for C–O; dry glassware; avoid wet carbonate slurries unless specifically validated.
Add 2–4 mol% additional Pd or 5–10 mol% Cu and continue heating.
